author: Felipe Blassioli
abstract: Routes a task to a Claude model + effort. Classifies the task into an archetype (deliberation / execution / recon / escalation) via the routing_rubric in ~/.claude/model-profiles.md, emits the durable tier + effort verdict first, then resolves today's model string from that file's tier_to_model (the only place a concrete model id lives). Recommends per phase for multi-phase work (plan on deliberation, implement on execution, review on deliberation). Holds no inline routing — the shared file is the single source read at runtime, so nothing rots on a model release. Emits tier + effort even when the model table is stale or unreadable, and flags the staleness rather than guessing a string. The same file is also read by the loop-compiler plugin.
